title: How Thieves Steal a Car Without the Key
description: A stickman explainer of the relay attack: two thieves, one key inside the house, one car on the drive.

scenes.title: the key never leaves the house
scenes.voice: Your car key is on the hallway table, inside the house, where it is safe. It is also still talking.

scenes.title: one of them listens at the door
scenes.voice: One thief stands at your front door with an amplifier and listens for the key. The wall is not a problem.

scenes.title: the second one holds the car door
scenes.voice: He passes the signal to a second thief standing at your car. The car believes the key is right there.

scenes.title: gone in twenty seconds
scenes.voice: The door unlocks, the engine starts, and the car is gone in about twenty seconds. Nothing was broken.

scenes.title: a five euro pouch stops it
scenes.voice: Drop the key in a signal blocking pouch and the amplifier hears nothing at all. Five euros, problem over.

scenes.title: Follow for the next one
scenes.voice: Check your own key tonight. Follow, and next time we open a car with a laptop.
